title: Synthetic Data Generator and Missing Values Imputation
summary: A Streamlit web application that lets users upload tabular data, fit synthetic data generators, and evaluate the quality of the generated output. It directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer, along with SDV's metadata detection and evaluate_quality functions, to produce and assess synthetic tables.
evidence: sdv_model.py:23-40 instantiates GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, fits, saves, and calls evaluate_quality
